header.title: MediKiosk
header.subhead: Pre-consultation clinical data intake platform for fast-track OPD registration.

welcome.title: MEDIKIOSK
welcome.subtitle: Quick 2-minute preliminary health check & symptom recording before seeing your OPD doctor.
welcome.voice_desc: Speak or tap your symptoms easily in your preferred language.
welcome.time_desc: Fast-tracks doctor consultation by pre-arranging your complaint summary.
welcome.privacy_desc: Your health information is directly routed to your assigned OPD physician.
welcome.footer_hint: Touch screen or press START button to begin • Contact helpdesk if assistance is needed

language_select.title: Select your language
language_select.subtitle: Choose the language you prefer for voice guidance and symptom recording.
language_select.desc_text: MediKiosk will display instructions and accept voice input in this language.

patient_id.title: Patient Identification
patient_id.subtitle: Choose whether you are registering as a new patient or lookup an existing hospital ID.
patient_id.demo_list_desc: Click any demo patient ID below to load pre-existing hospital records.
patient_id.new_patient_desc: Enter basic patient details to create a new intake session.

consent.title: Patient Information & Privacy Consent
consent.subtitle: Please read or listen to how your health information will be processed before proceeding.
consent.info_collected_desc: Chief symptoms, health duration, basic vitals, and preliminary health complaints.
consent.why_collected_desc: To prepare a pre-consultation summary so your OPD doctor can review your condition faster.
consent.ai_role_desc: AI organizes your spoken or typed symptoms into structured medical terms and translates regional languages.
consent.doctor_review_desc: Your assigned OPD doctor will personally review all details. Final diagnosis and treatment decisions are strictly made by your doctor.
consent.decline_modal_desc: Automated clinical intake requires patient agreement to process symptoms for your OPD doctor.
consent.decline_advice_1: You may visit the manual OPD Registration Counter #03 to register directly with staff.
consent.decline_advice_2: Or click 'Review & Agree' to continue with MediKiosk.

chief_complaint.question: What brings you to the hospital today?
chief_complaint.subtitle: Tap a common complaint below, speak using the microphone, or type your health problem.
chief_complaint.custom_input_label: Your Complaint Summary (Typed or Voice Transcribed)
chief_complaint.custom_input_placeholder: Describe your symptoms, how long you've had them, etc.
chief_complaint.voice_instruction: Press the Voice Assistant button to speak your complaint in English or Hindi.

doc_upload.title: Upload Past Medical Records & Prescriptions
doc_upload.subtitle: Attach previous doctor prescriptions, lab test reports, or discharge summaries (JPG, PNG, PDF only).
doc_upload.drag_drop_text: Tap here to select file or scan medical document
doc_upload.invalid_type_error: Invalid file format. Only JPG, PNG, and PDF files are allowed.

ocr.title: Extracted Structured Medical Information
ocr.disclaimer_text: Preliminary AI/OCR extractions are pre-consultation summaries. All values must be reviewed and verified by your assigned OPD physician.

red_flag.patient_priority_banner: Priority clinical assessment recommended based on reported symptoms.
red_flag.patient_priority_hint: Please inform OPD reception counter staff upon arrival for expedited triage.
red_flag.doctor_alert_title: DOCTOR TRIAGE ALERT: Priority Assessment Required
red_flag.doctor_alert_subtitle: Deterministic Red-Flag Rules Triggered for this Encounter

clinical_summary.title: AI Clinical Intake Summary
clinical_summary.subtitle: Structured pre-consultation summary prepared for attending OPD physician.
clinical_summary.safety_notice: AI organized summary strictly reflects patient inputs. No diagnoses or treatment prescriptions are generated.

doctor_dashboard.title: OPD Doctor Triage & Clinical Dashboard
doctor_dashboard.department: Dept of General Medicine • OPD Counter #01
doctor_dashboard.search_placeholder: Search patient name, ID, or symptoms...
doctor_dashboard.select_patient_prompt: Select a patient from the queue to view full clinical intake record.

med_history.title: Patient Medical & Health History
med_history.subtitle: Tap or enter any existing health conditions, medications, allergies, or surgeries.
med_history.family_history_placeholder: Describe any relevant hereditary illnesses in family (e.g. Father had Diabetes)

session.created_desc: Complete patient session payload saved to backend server.

instructions.voice_prompt: Speak your chief complaint into the microphone
instructions.tap_hint: Tap any option on the touch screen to select
instructions.elderly_guidance: Press the microphone button at any time for voice assistance.

errors.complaint_required: Please select or describe your chief complaint before proceeding
errors.mobile_invalid: Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number
errors.select_patient: Please select a demo patient or complete new patient form
